Normalize multislice spatial transcriptomics (ST) data

Source: R/main_wrapper.R
MultiNorm.Rd

Performs normalization of multislice ST data using a negative binomial model with spatial biological effects, library-size-associated technical effects, and slice-specific technical intercept deviations.

Usage

MultiNorm(
  spe_list,
  niche_col,
  preferred_niches = NULL,
  spot_frac = 1,
  verbose = FALSE,
  df_bio = c(6, 6),
  df_tech = c(3, 3),
  lambdaC = 10000,
  lambda1 = 0.01,
  lambda2 = 2,
  max_outer = 20,
  max_inner = 100,
  tol_disp = 1e-04,
  tol_param = 1e-05,
  psi_damp = 1,
  param_damp = 0.2,
  seed = 1,
  alpha_init = NULL,
  Beta_init = NULL,
  Gamma_init = NULL,
  Psi_init = NULL,
  zeta_init = NULL,
  rho_init = NULL,
  A = NULL,
  return_fit = FALSE
)

Arguments

spe_list

List of SpatialExperiment objects, one per slice. Each object must contain a column with spot-level niche annotations.

niche_col

Character or integer. Column name or index in colData specifying niche labels. Niches represent biologically similar clusters shared across slices.

preferred_niches

Optional vector specifying a subset of niche labels. Default is NULL, in which case all shared niches are used.

spot_frac

Numeric in (0, 1]. Proportion of spots to sample for model fitting. Default is 1.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, prints sampling details. Default is FALSE.

df_bio

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying degrees of freedom for the two-dimensional spline basis used to model biological spatial effects. Default is c(6, 6).

df_tech

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying degrees of freedom for the two-dimensional spline basis used to model library-size-associated technical effects. Default is c(3, 3).

lambdaC

Numeric. Penalty coefficient enforcing similarity of biological effects across matched niches and slices. Default is 10000.

lambda1

Numeric. Ridge regularization parameter for biological spline coefficients. Default is 0.01.

lambda2

Numeric. Ridge regularization parameter for technical spline coefficients. Default is 2.

max_outer

Integer. Maximum number of outer iterations for dispersion updates. Default is 20.

max_inner

Integer. Maximum number of inner IRWLS iterations for model parameter updates. Default is 100.

tol_disp

Numeric. Convergence tolerance for dispersion updates. Default is 1e-4.

tol_param

Numeric. Convergence tolerance for inner-loop parameter updates. Default is 1e-5.

psi_damp

Numeric in (0, 1]. Damping factor for dispersion updates. Default is 1.

param_damp

Numeric in (0, 1]. Damping factor for IRWLS parameter updates. Default is 0.2.

seed

Integer. Random seed used for spot subsampling. Default is 1.

alpha_init

Optional numeric vector of initial values for slice-specific global library-size effects. Should have length equal to the number of slices. Default is NULL.

Beta_init

Optional list of initial biological spline coefficient matrices. Each element should have dimension Kb x G, where Kb is the number of biological spline basis functions and G is the number of genes. Default is NULL.

Gamma_init

Optional list of initial technical spline coefficient matrices. Each element should have dimension Kt x G, where Kt is the number of technical spline basis functions. Default is NULL.

Psi_init

Optional list of initial dispersion vectors. Each element should have length G. Default is NULL.

zeta_init

Optional numeric vector of initial values for global gene-specific intercepts. Should have length G. Default is NULL.

rho_init

Optional matrix of initial values for slice-deviation contrast parameters. Should have dimension (S - 1) x G, where S is the number of slices and G is the number of genes. Default is NULL.

A

Optional sum-to-zero contrast matrix for slice-specific technical deviations. Should have dimension S x (S - 1) and satisfy colSums(A) == 0. If NULL, a default contrast matrix is constructed internally.

return_fit

Logical. If TRUE, returns fitted model parameters along with normalized data. Default is FALSE.

Value

If return_fit = FALSE, returns a list of SpatialExperiment objects with normalized values stored by norm_spe. If return_fit = TRUE, returns a list containing:

  • norm_spe: normalized SpatialExperiment objects.

  • fit: fitted model parameters.

  • call: matched function call.

  • Eta_full_list: fitted full linear predictors by slice.

  • percentiles: fitted NB percentiles used for PAC transformation.

Details

The method fits a negative binomial model with spatial biological effects, library-size-associated technical effects, and slice-specific technical intercept deviations. Biological and technical effects are modeled using two-dimensional spline bases. Cross-slice biological consistency is encouraged through matched niche-level constraints applied only to the biological spline component.

The model includes a global gene-specific intercept and a slice-specific technical intercept deviation represented using sum-to-zero contrasts. This allows slice-level technical shifts not explained by library size to be modeled explicitly, while preserving the biological niche-matching constraint on the biological component.

Parameter estimation is performed using iteratively reweighted least squares (IRWLS), with outer-loop updates for negative binomial dispersion parameters.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Basic usage
result <- MultiNorm(
  spe_list,
  niche_col = "niche"
)

# Access normalized output
norm_spe <- result

# Subsample spots for faster fitting
result <- MultiNorm(
  spe_list,
  niche_col = "niche",
  spot_frac = 0.5,
  seed = 123,
  verbose = TRUE
)

# Tune spline flexibility and regularization
result <- MultiNorm(
  spe_list,
  niche_col = "niche",
  df_bio = c(8, 8),
  df_tech = c(4, 4),
  lambda1 = 0.05,
  lambda2 = 2.0
)

# Use a subset of niches
result <- MultiNorm(
  spe_list,
  niche_col = "niche",
  preferred_niches = c("A", "B", "C")
)

# Return fitted model parameters
result <- MultiNorm(
  spe_list,
  niche_col = "niche",
  return_fit = TRUE
)

norm_spe <- result$norm_spe
fit <- result$fit
} # }
